His shrine in Trenggaran, Situbono, Aceh, Indonesia, attracts thousands of pilgrims during the annual Syaban Festival. The festival commemorates the saint's life, teachings, and miracles, illustrating the rich cultural heritage and diverse religious practices within the Islamic tradition.
